evidence.heading: Eight fixed article briefs and final acceptance checklist
evidence.excerpt: The user supplied exact titles, languages, keywords, link anchors, section structures, FAQ questions, visual notes, cover prompts, safety boundaries, and 500-800 word acceptance limits.

evidence.heading: Observed AI-to-demo workflow

evidence.heading: Deadlock product categories

evidence.heading: Foxhole logistics and information categories

evidence.heading: GTA 5 RP framework compatibility
evidence.excerpt: At capture time on 2026-08-05, the FAQ states that the product is intended for RAGE:MP and not for alt:V, Majestic, or other multiplayer modifications. Readers must recheck current wording.

evidence.heading: Comparison article as a dated market snapshot
evidence.excerpt: The source compares four products using feature, price, and protection claims. The Tier 2 brief requires a reusable evaluation method instead of repeating ranks, current prices, or safety claims.

evidence.heading: article-editorial-poster-v1
evidence.excerpt: Generated visual prompts require one dominant tactile hero, explicit thesis and metaphor, a limited palette, physically plausible materials, a safe zone, reference roles, explicit constraints, and a score of at least 80.

evidence.heading: Product mapping and evidence discipline
evidence.excerpt: Product discussion must remain high-level, feature-oriented, and grounded; operational implementation and absolute safety claims are prohibited.

strict_rules: Write exactly eight standalone articles in the assigned language and topic order.
Use exactly two Markdown links per article, with the exact assigned anchors and URL.
Keep the two links separated by at least two full H2 sections.
Keep editorial copy including FAQ between 500 and 800 words, with a preferred range of 650 to 750.
Do not use markdown tables or volatile commercial and safety claims.
Do not provide implementation, concealment, anti-cheat evasion, or exploit instructions.
Use the supplied article-editorial-poster-v1 cover prompt and a factual screenshot placement note in every article.
